correctness.rationale: Circulation balance is used to prove invariance of every fixed-N uniform sector; homogeneous Langmuir kinetics generates the independent Bernoulli stationary mixture. Conditioning on marked birth/death events gives an exchangeable post-event law; its two-point occupancy expectation relaxes as exp(-(lambda+delta)t). Conditioning on marked signed hops preserves N and yields the reverse-order regression via Cov(j,N)=B rho(1-rho)(1-2rho). Integrating the sum of chronological kernels proves the finite-time covariance. Full-state generator reconstruction passes 40 independent finite-state checks; the analytic proof, not those tests, handles arbitrary finite balanced graphs.

value.rationale: Particle reservoirs and transport counters measure different event types. The exact chronological asymmetry versus equality of integrated reaction/current covariances resolves a natural non-equilibrium fluctuation question on all finite balanced exclusion graphs, including lane-anisotropic periodic 2D ASEP-LK. Half filling gives zero mixed counting covariances with positive mean current, a sharp nontrivial cancellation. The theorem supplies structure that cannot be inferred from the previously known product stationary law or mean current alone.
